problem: With batch8, baseline omitted each ninth conversation every sweep. Fixed 50-conversation diagnostic observed accepted50 pages/500messages instead45/450.
alternatives: Increasing batch merely shifts skipped boundaries; extra sleeps cannot visit excluded rows; foreground sealing violates archive worker publication ownership. Keep batch/page/poll limits and all source/OCC/digest fences.
